title: 151 Thomas Moore Road, Walkinstown, Dublin 12
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are proud to present 151 Thomas Moore Road, Walkinstown, Dublin 12 to the market – an exceptional six-bedroom, three bathroom detached family home occupying a prime position on one of Walkinstown's most established and highly sought-after residential roads. Rarely does an opportunity arise to acquire a detached home of this size and scale in such a convenient location. Residents are spoiled for choice with an excellent selection of local amenities nearby including Ashleaf Shopping Centre, SuperValu Walkinstown, cafés, restaurants and local shops, together with a host of highly regarded primary and secondary schools. The area also boasts excellent sporting and recreational facilities, while numerous Dublin Bus routes, the M50, N7 and Dublin City Centre are all easily accessible.

Bright and generously proportioned internal living accommodation spans to an impressive 223 sqm. On the ground floor you will find, spacious entrance hallway, dining room, two reception rooms, a fully fitted kitchen, living room, utility room, and guest w/c. The first-floor hosts, six spacious bedrooms, family bathroom, and master en-suite. Perfect for growing families. The impressive footprint provides the successful purchaser with an outstanding opportunity to redesign and create a truly spectacular forever home.

No. 151 is presented as a clean blank canvas and is in need of modernisation throughout, offering endless potential to renovate and transform the property to your own taste and specification. The true standout feature is the remarkable rear garden, which is exceptionally large and rarely found in a Dublin home. This incredible outdoor space offers outstanding potential for further extension, outdoor entertaining, landscaping or even creating your own private oasis, subject to the necessary planning permissions. The property further benefits from a private driveway providing ample off-street parking and a large block-built shed to the rear offering excellent storage, but also offers the potential to be the perfect home office, granny flat, or workshop.

Detached homes of this scale, coupled with such an extraordinary garden, rarely come to the market. Combining generous accommodation, unrivalled outdoor space and limitless potential in a prime Walkinstown location, No. 151 represents a once-in-a-generation opportunity for growing families seeking their forever home.

Early viewing is highly recommended – contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers today to arrange a viewing!
